headword: {相対性理論|そうたいせいりろん}

definitions.gloss: the theory of relativity (Einstein's physics of space, time, and gravity)
definitions.explanation: Einstein's theory that the laws of physics are the same for all observers and that space and time depend on the observer's motion; it comprises the special theory (1905) and the general theory of gravity (1915).

examples.english: To study the theory of relativity.
